IMPROVED category consistency: actual moving or stationary aircraft/boat hulls use the same projection, vertical/lane overlap, measured crossing course and cap policy rather than limiting categories to wreck state.

The existing rear swept-hull observer now discovers the same three vehicle categories and retains dead Air/Ship hulls through actor admission. Live infantry stays separate. Existing64actor/250metre limits, overlap windows, turning sweep and independent rays remain unchanged.

RETAINED bounded discovery radius,256 hull projections/64 retained predictions, dense/scheduled refusal, reaction headroom, predecessor/queue authority and independent geometry sensing. No extra scan, cache, worker or command writer.

REJECTED source global allDead iteration and60second placed-object grid as required collision authority; current live area discovery/geometry retains existing owner and no cached-clearance permission.
remaining: Physical road crossing/taxiing aircraft, grounded boat/wreck, vertically separated traffic, modded bounding boxes and performance unverified; audits paused.

Hull projection is conservative box occupancy, not exact surface or route clearance. Standard class discovery may not retain every engine replacement wreck class; geometry sampling remains independent.
External provider all-writer quiescence, precision/distance LOD and complete HBQ integration remain open.
Passing/bypass/queue planners retain independent geometry/occupancy contracts; this scoped observer correction does not prove their whole-route clearance or every vehicle category across the mod.
